attribution.name: 王远
attribution.note: The report names 王远 as the writer of the calligraphy. It does not separate the composition of the text from the brushing.
attribution.noteZh: 报道记《石门铭》由王远书。报道未区分撰文与书丹。

background: 北魏永平二年（509）刻于褒斜道石门崖壁，记梁秦二州刺史羊祉奏请重开褒斜道、左校令贾三德率众修复之事。原刻在石门崖壁，后凿移，现藏汉中市博物馆，为「石门十三品」之一。

review.note: Draft record from a government interview page and a broadcaster's feature, both read on 2026-11-18. The date and the museum holding come from the government page; the two credited hands come from the feature. Neither is a catalogue entry, and the stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的政府访谈页与央广报道整理。年代与收藏机构取自政府页，两位署名者取自报道。两者都不是馆方目录条目；未核对原石。

notes: No measured dimensions are given by the cited pages, so none is stored.
The government page dates the inscription to 509 and lists it among the 石门十三品; it does not name a writer or carver.
The feature names 王远 and 武阿仁 but does not distinguish who composed the text from who brushed it; only the calligraphy is credited here.
The cliff face was cut out and moved into the museum; the object record describes the moved block, not an in-situ cliff.
notesZh: 所引页面没有实测尺寸，故不填写。
政府页面定年为 509，并列入「石门十三品」，但未记撰书与刻字者。
报道记王远、武阿仁，但未区分撰文与书丹；本记录只归书丹。
原崖面经凿割移入博物馆；实物记录描述的是移入后的石块，不是原址摩崖。
